candidates.editorial_note: Codex 0.152.1 kept all 209 skills visible in the final capture but compressed 100 project descriptions to 40–44 characters. Front-loaded implicit discovery succeeded 3/3; an opaque rear trigger shortened away succeeded 1/3. The existing route was live-verified after deployment with HTTP 200, self-canonical metadata, index/follow, and both result markers. Treat the behavioral sample as directional and do not claim an omission threshold.
